MacRumors reports that in addition to the event Apple is expected to hold on October 13, the company also plans to announce another batch of new products in the last week of October. Here are the details.

New Macs and an OLED iPad mini expected before year end

Last weekend, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman claimed that Apple will hold an event on October 13 to unveil a "long-awaited smart home hub with a screen, a new HomePod mini, and an updated Apple TV."

Gurman's report comes amid questions about whether Apple will hold an event or, as in the past, announce new products via video and press release. Gurman had previously only said Apple would unveil these products on October 13, without specifying the format of the announcement.

In addition to these three products, Apple has previously been expected to announce a new OLED iPad mini and new Macs, including an updated iMac with the M6 chip and an OLED MacBook Pro with a touchscreen.

Citing "multiple people familiar with the matter," MacRumors said Apple will announce another round of new products in the last week of October.

The report did not specify which products would be announced, nor did it provide a specific date, or say whether Apple will hold a second event or announce products via video and press release.

However, these end-of-month announcements will cap off an unusually busy October for Apple, as the iPhone Duo goes on sale on October 23, and the company is also expected to release quarterly results before the end of October.

What do you think about Apple holding another round of product announcements later this month? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
